svg.text: Recovery decomposition: the boundaries SPEC §5 defines, and the source of each
SPEC.md §5; internal/detect/detect.go. Boundaries on one axis from the fire; spacing is schematic, and nothing orders goodput restored relative to the probes.
Black-hole (finite full-node network partition; recovery is partition heal)
the pinned 120 s partition, pre-armed expiry
Heal anchor: the observed partition expiry, else the fire anchor plus the pinned 120 s. Partition-heal recovery is measured from the
fire anchor, is bounded below by 120 s, and is never reported as node-loss recovery or compared with clean delete as the same thing.
Time to single-replica equilibrium concerns the survivor only and is reported for both variants. Only measured boundaries are
claimed; a boundary with no evidence is reported N/A, never inferred.
